info.title: Brain API
info.description: The commands and queries another system uses. Every request is a POST naming one entry in `type`; `x-brain-operations` gives each entry's input, output and the least role it needs. The file describes the commit it is in: it changes when Brain does.

200.description: The output of the named entry (x-brain-operations says which schema)

default.description: A refusal, with the matching HTTP status
